Definition: shade of death, i.e. the grave (figuratively, calamity)
BiblicalUsage: 1) death-shadow, deep shadow, deep darkness, shadow of death; 1a) death-shadow; 1b) death-shadow, deep shadow, darkness; 1c) death-shadow (of distress, extreme danger) (fig); 1d) death-shadow (of place of the dead) (fig)
